voice.summary: Relay speaks in the clear one-liners of well-designed software: what happened, what can be done, nothing more. It gives developers short examples and names the toast type in plain words.
dos: State the outcome first, then offer an action
Use consistent verbs across toast types
donts: Do not use alarming language for warnings

taglines: Undo is always one click away
boilerplate: Relay is a notification toolkit for product teams, offering success, warning, error and info toasts with timers, undo and a history drawer.
